assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art background extension for a 2D side-scrolling metroidvania. Match the reference's chunky crisp pixel scale, yellow-green smog backlight, near-black olive/rust shadows, corroded scrap, tires, crushed machinery, moss, overhead dangling chains and cables, distant junk cranes. Keep the central playable band relatively open. Continue the SAME lighting, depth and horizon, with dark clutter concentrated along bottom and occasional overhead silhouettes. For stitching, both vertical edges should be mostly yellow-green fog and distant low-contrast silhouettes, WITHOUT a black frame, cave side wall, vignette side closure or foreground vertical column. Side-view orthographic environment, no characters, no UI, no text, no logos, no watermarks. The artwork must look like another stretch of the supplied junkyard, not a new biome, and must extend sideways rather than zooming or repeating its central hanging machine.
